body.text: I asked you for something, {param:months_ago} months ago now, and you told me no.
I have not written about it since and I am not writing to ask again. I only mention it because {param:town} has not forgotten, and I had rather you heard that from me than from the returns.
A town remembers who helped it. It remembers the other thing longer.

options.text: and have read it with care
and would rather not have needed it

options.label: say you are sorry for it
options.text: You are right to mention it, and I am sorry for it. It was not given lightly and I do not refuse lightly.

options.label: say the answer stands
options.text: The answer was the right one then and I will not pretend otherwise now.
